title: Make Tuna discoverable by its project name
problem: The LV2 project and plugin names omit Tuna, so hosts that search only human-readable doap:name values cannot find the plugin by its project name.
reproduce: Generate tuna.ttl from current templates and search its three doap:name values for Tuna; none match on the baseline.
acceptance: The project, normal tuner and spectrum tuner names all contain Tuna, preserve their x42 branding and remain synchronized with compiled descriptor headers.
repair: Include Tuna in the project and instance doap:name templates and update the checked-in generated descriptor names.

verification.limitations: BCL checks the generated metadata contract and compiled descriptor names. A separate clean dependency image builds the LV2 DSP and OpenGL UI; BCL does not launch a graphical plugin host.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the candidate in an LV2 host that searches doap:name and confirm searching Tuna lists both the normal and Spectrum variants.
